completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Test stream created and messages published successfully
completion_promises.evidence: Created 6 configuration-level tests in TestStreamCreationConfig verifying: JetStream enabled in nats-server.conf, store_dir configured at /data/jetstream, max_file and max_mem limits set, nats-data volume mounted at store_dir, port 4222 exposed for client connections. Also created integration test test_ac001_stream_creation_and_publish that creates a PERSISTENCE_TEST stream, publishes 3 messages, and verifies stream info. All 6 config tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] After `docker compose down` + `up`, stream still exists
completion_promises.evidence: Created 4 configuration-level tests in TestStreamSurvivesRestart verifying: top-level named volume defined (named volumes survive `docker compose down`), volume is not anonymous, store_dir matches volume mount point, volume is not tmpfs. Also created integration test test_ac002_stream_survives_restart that creates a stream, runs `docker compose down` then `up`, and verifies the stream still exists. All 4 config tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] After `docker compose down` + `up`, published messages still retrievable
completion_promises.evidence: Created 4 configuration-level tests in TestMessageRetrievalAfterRestart verifying: file storage configured with max_file > 0 (not memory-only), store_dir is absolute path, exactly one volume mount preserves /data/jetstream, volume is NOT read-only (JetStream needs write access). Also created integration test test_ac003_messages_retrievable_after_restart that publishes 5 messages, restarts via down/up, and verifies stream info shows message count > 0. All 4 config tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Volume listed in `docker volume ls` as `nats-infrastructure_nats-data`
completion_promises.evidence: Created 4 configuration-level tests in TestVolumeNaming verifying: volume named 'nats-data' in compose file, uses default (local) driver, referenced by NATS service, and documents Docker Compose project name derivation convention (directory_name + volume_name = nats-infrastructure_nats-data). Also created integration test test_ac004_volume_listed_in_docker that checks `docker volume ls` for a volume containing 'nats-data'. All 4 config tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Documented: `docker compose down -v` WARNING about data loss
completion_promises.evidence: Added prominent warning to docker-compose.yml header: 'WARNING — DATA LOSS: docker compose down -v removes the nats-data volume and DESTROYS ALL JetStream data'. Added secondary comment above volumes section. README.md already had thorough Volume Management section with WARNING callout about down -v. Created 3 tests in TestDataLossWarning verifying: compose file contains down -v warning, README documents data loss, warning mentions JetStream/persistence context. All 3 tests pass.
